title: AI-text detector evaluation: source catalogue
status: Research catalogue and proposed sampling budget, not an assembled benchmark or detector result.
verification: Author-maintained dataset cards, project pages and papers inspected through web access. Bulk data were not downloaded or exhaustively audited; proposed slice counts require inventory and overlap checks.
scope: English-first; preserve independent domain, authorship, generation-mechanism and provenance dimensions.

notes: This is a target, not confirmed per-cell availability.
Keep scholarly abstracts and body prose distinguishable; allow unfilled cells.
Calibration examples are additional and disjoint by original source.
Related versions and repeated authors are not independent observations.

sources.name: LLMTrace detection
caveats: Other mixed mechanisms are not equivalent to gap replacement.
Human sources require date/provenance auditing; web-derived human labels are not individually verified.
Check overlap across classification and detection releases.

sources.name: LLMTrace classification
caveats: Balance generator and generation task; source dates need auditing.
Related sources may also occur in LLMTrace detection.

sources.name: RAID
sources.role: binary domain diagnostics and separate robustness panel
caveats: Official test labels are not publicly supplied.
Labelled train is not unseen evaluation for RAID-trained baselines.
Variants share source documents; generators are primarily from the 2024 benchmark era.

sources.name: DAMASHA / MAS
sources.role: replacement mixtures and separate perturbation robustness
caveats: Remove label tags while reconstructing offsets before inference.
Default HF viewer reports incompatible CSV schemas; choose individual files.
Includes TriBERT and M4GT, and reuses MAGE/M4 source material.
Validate released row-to-domain/generator/mechanism mapping before enforcing quotas.

sources.name: AITDNA
caveats: Nine views are not nine independent corpora.
Default original view contains edit histories, requiring reconstruction.
Document-view AI labels use a 50% threshold, not an any-AI rule.
Use metadata author/session grouping; 95 human controls are not sufficient for precise low-FPR estimates.

sources.name: Beemo
sources.role: matched pure-human, AI-output and expert-edited-AI challenge
sources.license_as_listed: Field-dependent: No Robots fields CC-BY-NC-4.0; expert edits MIT subject to model terms; generated text subject to generator terms
caveats: human_edits is NOT human-only.
No exact causal replacement-span gold.
Deduplicate No Robots human outputs across rows and external uses.

sources.name: IMDb
caveats: Dataset label is sentiment, not AI authorship.
Historical source evidence is not per-review keystroke verification.
Handle HTML consistently; audit source terms.

sources.name: XSum
sources.license_note: Source-content rights require review; do not infer news rights from repository code license.
caveats: Use original documents, not model-produced summaries.
May overlap detector benchmarks built on XSum.

sources.name: Scientific Papers
sources.role: historical scholarly abstracts and body-paragraph candidates
caveats: Old HF loading script; use verified source files or a checked conversion.
Math placeholders and extraction artifacts can confound comparisons.
Audit article-specific source licenses; keep papers grouped.

sources.name: WikiText
caveats: Rows are not independent documents; reconstruct article boundaries.
Check historical Wikipedia source overlap with detector training data.

sources.name: PG-19
sources.group_field: book URL / book ID; additionally author
sources.license_as_listed: Apache-2.0 on dataset card; verify underlying book rights
caveats: Historical style is not a proxy for modern writing.
Contains lexical substitutions and some transcription/front-matter artifacts.
HF loader is legacy; original project files may be preferable.

sources.name: PERSUADE 2.0
sources.provenance: Original corpus of US grades 6-12 student essays; 15 prompts
caveats: Use author-maintained original distribution, not AI-augmented competition amalgamations.
Collection dates were not independently verified during this review.
Group by writer where identifiers permit.

sources.name: No Robots
sources.provenance: Skilled human annotators; vendor instructed not to use LLM-generated outputs
caveats: Curator attestation, not publicly logged token provenance.
Use original English, not machine-translated derivatives.
Overlaps Beemo human_output.

sources.name: MAGE
sources.role: reserve / in-distribution regression when already used for training
caveats: Not independent evaluation if previously used for detector development.
Parent texts are reused in other detection corpora.

sources.name: Open Pangram / EditLens
sources.role: optional AI-editing test, distinct from block replacement
sources.access: Gated: login and acceptance of contact-sharing conditions
caveats: AI editing is not exact replacement-span provenance.
Gated files were not inspected.
Not independent of EditLens-trained baselines.

sources.name: CoAuthor
caveats: Older generator distribution.
Replay edits and accepted suggestions to recover final provenance.
Group by writer/session; license not verified in this review.
